protocol.Mode: Fresh-process single-setting ablations; controls every five (two in adaptive follow-up); no concurrent tests/builds during traces; reject whole unfocused/invalid traces
protocol.Interpretation: Stationary marginal cost, not universal benefit; sub-noise or unexercised paths remain unresolved
protocol.AdaptiveFollowup: After B03, added two further observations each for grid-bounds and fluid-topology because initial single-run effects were large. Original 61-run schedule retained.

notes: Positive change means disabling/altering the feature made this scene slower; factory-cadence instead enables divisor 2.
Every run and invalidity flag is retained. Review all flags and configuration/module receipts.
References use native factory cadence with other shipping defaults. Ablations are marginal effects in that combination.
Elapsed start receipts approximate control position; startup duration and workload evolution limit precision.
One-run screens cannot establish small effects. Low-impact or unexercised features remain unresolved.
Do not sum feature effects or infer simulation safety from performance.

factory-cadence.decision: Discard from the preservation profile; use divisor 1
factory-cadence.behaviour: Known meaningful failures: missed one-tick signal pulse, feedback advances half as often, lost factory time on transitions into native-rate controls, and different power-interruption output. A performance gain cannot qualify this as equivalent.
factory-cadence.coverage: CadenceEvidenceTests, FactoryOutcomeTests, StableCircuitExecutionTests; actual installed feature ablation.

picking.decision: Discard throttle from preservation defaults; use divisor 1
picking.behaviour: Actual camera gate adds up to two rendered frames of ID-buffer age in the calibrated native render-target check. Native interaction consumes that buffer. No wrong native click was demonstrated; responsiveness is not certified.
picking.coverage: Native red/green camera calibration with shipping gate enabled/disabled, after FPS capture. Forced readback wall times are excluded from ordinary input-latency claims.

stable-signals.decision: Keep conditionally at native factory cadence
stable-signals.behaviour: Native and configured circuits match intermediate state in the tested changing/stable chain, including variable step lengths; redundant callbacks deliberately coalesce. Observer-mod compatibility and arbitrary topology are not established.
stable-signals.coverage: Native Mono circuit differential plus StableCircuitExecutionTests and StableSignalTests. Factory cadence is held at 1.

signal-queries.behaviour: Scoped input projection retains native execution ordering and live values in the tested circuit. Topology invalidation and role guards also have offline contracts.
signal-queries.coverage: Native circuit differential with actual installed projection, SignalEvaluationTests and PatchCompositionTests.

single-player-rooms.decision: Keep within tested native and loopback scope
single-player-rooms.behaviour: Forwarded queries matched authoritative geometry through actual hull removal/restoration. On real second-process join the local tree rebuilt from one leaf to 208,279; host-local/remote geometry and disconnect checks passed with forwarding enabled and disabled. Native client mirrors can transiently lag after edits. WAN/Steam transport, gas replication and remote production remain open.
single-player-rooms.coverage: Native real-ship query fixtures, matched-binary two-process loopback checks and SinglePlayerRoomTests.

incremental-rooms.decision: Keep with documented numerical tolerance and limits
incremental-rooms.behaviour: Repeated topology/volume/seed and gas-identity checks pass. Floating-point atmosphere differs slightly from native; weighted-reference error and repeated-edit drift are documented. Universal threshold equivalence is not claimed.
incremental-rooms.coverage: IncrementalRoomTests, native synthetic edit/join/breach/reseal/gas-reload fixtures, actual real-ship hull edits. Targeted edit timings are separate from stationary FPS.

physics-transforms.decision: Review/split redundant setters from scene caching
physics-transforms.behaviour: Forced-gravity dynamic bodies matched position, velocity, rotation and sleep state exactly in six paired 600-step scenarios. Same-delegate setter benchmarks measured approximately 20 ns native versus 37 ns guarded. Whole-feature frame effect is inconclusive; review/split setters from scene caching. No demonstrated numerical physics regression; full ship interpolation/docking/space reassignment remain open.
physics-transforms.coverage: Matched-binary native dynamic bodies with floor arrival and sleeping counts, fair alternating-order benchmarks, three whole-feature frame comparisons and PhysicsSceneTests. Initial zero-gravity floor probe does not prove collision/reactivation coverage.

stateful-queries.behaviour: Native membership, iteration order and live part state agree after tested add/remove and reused IDs. Snapshot lifetime and arbitrary mod mutation are outside this guarantee.
stateful-queries.coverage: Native 2,000 mutation/query comparisons with actual installed cache hooks, QueryCacheTests, all 25 patched call-site contracts.

native-state-reuse.behaviour: Preserves field bits and native publications while reusing equal immutable records. Custom derived records retain fallback clone semantics. Reference-identity observers remain a compatibility distinction.
native-state-reuse.coverage: Native circuit state/event comparisons and NativeStateReuseTests, including signed zero and NaN payloads.

world-snapshots.decision: Conditional keep; broader runtime mutation coverage open
world-snapshots.behaviour: Scoped reuse has offline membership/order, nesting and cleanup contracts. Stationary native run exercises normal loading, not all despawn/travel mutations.
world-snapshots.coverage: SnapshotPatchTests, native frame ablation; no full world-lifecycle certification.

cable-buffers.behaviour: Exact-length cleared scratch buffers retain tested mesh data and nested-call separation. Dynamic native wiring/mesh-upload coverage remains open.
cable-buffers.coverage: CableScopeTests, ReuseTests and native frame ablation.

grid-bounds.behaviour: Native bounds match after 1,000 actual grid mutations across positive/negative coordinates and chunk boundaries. Native stateful hull additions route through the hooked SetPart path; removals have their own hook.
grid-bounds.coverage: Native mutation differential and cached-read timings; QueryCacheTests; inspected native mutation call paths.

fluid-topology.decision: Keep guarded topology cache; review cosmetic refresh separately
fluid-topology.behaviour: Reuses visual topology while live flow values remain live. Offline topology invalidation passes; actual wiring/disconnect/retype and flow-reversal visual acceptance remain open. Disabling this feature also removes its fluid-flow refresh reuse: the ablation includes this interaction with CableVisualHz; it does not isolate topology caching at identical visual refresh frequency.
fluid-topology.coverage: CableTopologyTests, native frame ablation and screenshots.

part-visuals.decision: Conditional keep; moving presentation coverage open
part-visuals.behaviour: Equal-state work is deferred; simulation remains native. Offline changed-state and liquid-level contracts pass. Static views cannot establish all movement/billboard/refill transitions.
part-visuals.coverage: PartVisualTests, native frame ablation and screenshots.

tool-refs.decision: Conditional keep for inspected ModKit version
tool-refs.behaviour: Cached references preserve tested tool-switch and replacement behaviour. ModKit adapter is version/owner guarded; broad native tool switching remains open.
tool-refs.coverage: ToolRefsTests, OptionalModTests and native module/ablation receipts.

distiller-slots.decision: Keep within equal-slot contract; active-chain coverage open
distiller-slots.behaviour: Equal inventory arrays reuse identity; changed quantities and content retain the new array. Offline comparison passes. This is not an active native distiller production-chain certification. The native candidate array is still constructed before the replaced setter; this is not evidence that candidate-array allocation was eliminated.
distiller-slots.coverage: DistillerSlotTests and inspected native call-site composition; stationary frame ablation may not exercise active distillers.

world-visuals.behaviour: Exact transform/visual reuse has offline contracts; stationary native view supplies limited integration evidence.
world-visuals.coverage: ManagedPatchTests/PartVisualTests and native frame ablation; no broad travel/docking claim.

client-signals.decision: Conditional keep; native rewiring coverage open
client-signals.behaviour: Socket/membership projection preserves tested live values and supported/custom fallback behaviour. Dynamic native wire changes remain a release coverage gap.
client-signals.coverage: CableTopologyTests, OptionalAdapterTests and native frame ablation.

world-ui.decision: Conditional keep of culling; review presentation delays
world-ui.behaviour: Hidden UI is deferred and numeric readouts refresh at 10 Hz unless focused. This intentionally changes visible timing; focus/edit and low-FPS responsiveness are not proven by static screenshots.
world-ui.coverage: WorldUiAndBatchingTests/VisualTradeoffTests, native frame ablation and captured views.

ui-culling.decision: Conditional keep; visibility transitions remain open
ui-culling.behaviour: Offscreen canvas suppression has restoration/focus contracts. Multi-camera and native moving-view transitions need broader acceptance.

ui-distance.decision: Demote distance cap pending perceptual acceptance; prefer native
ui-distance.behaviour: 100 m cap intentionally omits distant readouts. It cannot receive an imperceptibility claim solely from a stationary near-field view. Zero restores native distance.
ui-distance.coverage: VisualTradeoffTests; isolated distance ablation. Actual distant-display acceptance remains open.

ui-refresh.decision: Demote refresh cap pending dynamic acceptance; prefer native
ui-refresh.behaviour: 10 Hz numeric display refresh adds a nominal refresh interval of delay plus frame scheduling; focused controls bypass throttling. Simulation values are live but readout timing differs.
ui-refresh.coverage: PendingDisplay transition tests; isolated refresh ablation. Native dynamic-readout input latency remains open.

renderer-detail.decision: Conditional visual keep; perceptibility remains unproven
renderer-detail.behaviour: Tiny geometry and distant shadows are intentionally omitted. Multi-camera conservative rules, near restoration and hysteresis have offline tests; view samples do not cover threshold travel or all lighting.
renderer-detail.coverage: VisualTradeoffTests, three-view captures and native ablation.

tiny-meshes.decision: Conditional visual keep; threshold acceptance open
tiny-meshes.behaviour: Default 3-pixel threshold can omit small distant meshes. Offline projection/hysteresis and near-field protection pass; popping across distance/FOV/resolution is not certified.

shadows.decision: Demote shadow cap pending visual parity evidence
shadows.behaviour: Default shadow-distance cap intentionally removes shadows beyond 40 m. These can be perceptible even when meshes are small; stationary FPS benefit is insufficient evidence of visual parity.
shadows.coverage: VisualTradeoffTests, isolated shadow-distance ablation and captured views; moving daylight acceptance remains open.

mesh-batching.decision: Conditional keep; dynamic restoration coverage open
mesh-batching.behaviour: Supported opaque renderers combine while gameplay objects/colliders stay present. Native startup logs establish actual replacements; static views do not certify hover/highlight, moving parts, lighting changes or all edits. Matched-build native highlight/removal calls restored five source renderers and retained the part object/state; the selected visual root had zero colliders, so no positive collider-identity result is claimed.
mesh-batching.coverage: WorldUiAndBatchingTests, native renderer inventory logs, frame ablation and screenshots; real hull edit integration.

terrain.decision: Conditional keep; travel/terrain edit coverage open
terrain.behaviour: Reuses LOD traversal for small observer movement with a 15-frame maximum interval. Intended target is presentation; unchanged observer does not prove arbitrary terrain edit/collision behaviour.
terrain.coverage: FrameCadenceTests and inspected visual call site; native stationary ablation and views. No travel/collider certification.

cable-refresh.decision: Demote fluid refresh throttle pending dynamic acceptance; keep graph cache
cable-refresh.behaviour: Fluid cosmetic values refresh at 20 Hz while animation runs each frame. Skipped signal passes still update glow from live values. Fluid refresh timing can differ by a nominal 50 ms plus frame scheduling; fast flow changes and low-FPS visual acceptance remain open.
cable-refresh.coverage: FrameCadenceTests/CableTopologyTests and native frame ablation; no electrical/fluid simulation cadence change from this switch.

loader-cache.behaviour: Replaces repeated reflection with the same sibling-order calls at the inspected update position. Version/layout guards fail closed; future loader versions require renewed inspection.
loader-cache.coverage: EntryPointTests/NativeContractTests and native runtime on/off module receipts.

packet-trailer.decision: Keep as bounded framing hardening; no FPS claim required
packet-trailer.behaviour: Capacity correction preserves native channel framing/payload under tested boundary lengths. This is not evidence of reduced bandwidth or WAN reliability.
packet-trailer.coverage: TrailerBoundaryTests, TrailerRegressionTests and native installed frame ablation; native loopback peer follow-up exercises the installed transport stack.
